theme.title: NBA Mix 07
theme.subtitle: Five moments from across NBA history
theme.recap: Five NBA stories, five different numbers: a quick tour of stars, teams, records and surprises.

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did Derrick Rose's 2010–11 Bulls win?
questions.note: 62 wins, earning the top seed in the Eastern Conference.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Bulls finished the season with a 62–20 record, the best in the league

funFacts.text: Derrick Rose became the youngest player to win NBA MVP, earning the award before his 23rd birthday.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Derrick Rose won the NBA Most Valuable Player Award, becoming the youngest NBA player ever to win the award, at the age of 22.

funFacts.text: Chicago head coach Tom Thibodeau won Coach of the Year in the same season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Tom Thibodeau wins NBA Coach of the Year

funFacts.text: Rose led the league's best-record team without a single All-Star teammate.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Derrick Rose won 2010-11 NBA MVP and led his team to the Best NBA Regular Season Record without any All-Star teammates.

source.quote: Battier scored 18 points on six 3-pointers to offset scoreless nights by Bosh and Allen

questions.prompt: Kobe Bryant made just six field goals in Game 7 of the 2010 Finals. How many did he attempt?
questions.note: 6 for 24, though his 23 points led all scorers.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Bryant, despite shooting 6 for 24 (25%) from the field, scored 10 of his game-high 23 points in the fourth quarter.

funFacts.text: The Lakers controlled the offensive glass and won the overall rebounding battle.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Lakers had 23 offensive rebounds and out-rebounded the Celtics, 53–40.

funFacts.text: Pau Gasol pulled down 18 rebounds in the championship clincher.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Gasol had 18 rebounds and Bryant added 15.

funFacts.text: Ron Artest chipped in 20 points, including a crucial late three-pointer.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Artest, who scored 20 points in Game 7 including his last-second three-pointer
